claims.claim: A USW(A&S) memo of 4 May 2026 lowered the DoD sole-source peer review trigger from $1B to $50M (streamlined over $50M, standard at $500M), while PGI 201.170 still prints $1B; DPCAP implementing memo USA001395-26.
claims.finding: Confirmed, with nuance. The 4 May 2026 USW(A&S) memo (attached to USA001395-26) directs that for all prospective sole-source defense acquisitions valued at $50 million or greater, contracting officers present prenegotiation objective positions for peer review to decide which facilitization costs to recognize, and says a DFARS change will revise the $1 billion threshold to $50 million, so it did not itself amend the DFARS. USA001395-26 sets the tiers: greater than $50M and less than $500M streamlined (facilitization costs, prime and major supplier historical costs, realized profits); $500M to under $1B the existing PGI 201.170 process; $1B and up unchanged under Class Deviation 2026-O0002. PGI 201.170(a)(1)(ii) in 2026-O0002 Rev. 1 (current revision, dated 5 Aug 2026 on the DFARS RFO deviation index last updated 9 Sep 2026) still says $1 billion. The DPCAP sole source peer review web page repeats the streamlined (over $50M to under $500M) and scheduled ($500M and up) paths. Appendix GG Rev. 30 shows 'above $50M' citing the 4 May memo. Minor gap: the USW memo says '$50 million or greater', DPCAP says 'greater than $50 million'.
claims.source: https://www.acq.osd.mil/dpap/policy/policyvault/USA001395-26-DPCAP.pdf; DFARS Class Deviation 2026-O0002 Rev. 1 Attachment 2; https://www.acq.osd.mil/asda/dpc/pcf/ss-peer-reviews.html; https://www.acq.osd.mil/dpap/dars/dfars_far_overhaul_class_deviations.html; AFARS Appendix GG Rev. 30

claims.claim: RFO FAR 16.104 implements Executive Order 14402, requiring an approved justification for non-fixed-price DoD contracts and orders of $100M or more, with ASA(ALT) as the Army approver.
claims.finding: Confirmed. E.O. 14402, Promoting Efficiency, Accountability, and Performance in Federal Contracting, signed 30 Apr 2026, published 5 May 2026 at 91 FR 24325 (FR doc 2026-08900); sec. 2(b)(ii)(A) requires agency-head approval above $100 million for Department of War non-fixed-price contracts. RFO FAR 16.104(b) states it implements the E.O.; covered means other than fixed-price, FFP level-of-effort term, or a hybrid; (c)(1)(i) 'at or above $100 million, for DoD'; (e)(1) exempts multiple-award contracts but not orders under them; (d)(2) delegation only to the CAO or another non-career SES. AFARS PGI 5116.104-7090 (PGI effective 31 Aug 2026): under HQDA General Order 2025-01 the Army approval authority is ASA(ALT), submitted through DASA(P). Nuance: the E.O. says 'exceeds' and covers contracts; FAR 16.104 says 'at or above' and extends to orders and FFP-LOE term.
claims.source: https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents/2026-08900.json and its full text; https://www.acquisition.gov/far-overhaul/far-part-deviation-guide/far-overhaul-part-16; DFARS Class Deviation 2026-O0045 Rev. 1 Attachment 2 (PGI 216.104-70); AFARS PGI 5116.104-7090

claims.claim: Order timing under the executive order (N433).
claims.finding: Not specified in any primary source. E.O. 14402 addresses contracts only. FAR 16.104(b) requires approval 'prior to using a covered contract or order', and (e)(1) applies the requirement to task orders, delivery orders and BPAs under multiple-award contracts. DFARS PGI 216.104-70 and AFARS PGI 5116.104-7090 give timelines only for solicitations (issued on or after, or before, 15 Jul 2026) and existing contracts. claims.claim: Whether Policy v12 sections 4.3 and 4.5 conflict for a legacy $500M warrant holder going unlimited (N419).
claims.finding: The tension is real and the policy does not resolve it. 4.5 exempts legacy holders from testing, re-boarding or reappointment for increases within the same Table 1 class, and $500M and Unlimited are both Class IV; 4.3 says passing the appropriate board is mandatory for an unlimited warrant and cannot be waived. Section 5 also lets an organization recognize a previously passed board for the same warrant type. The specific unlimited-warrant rule in 4.3 is the more defensible reading (board required), which is how N419 answers, flagged verify-locally. Section numbers are inferred from heading order and agree with the change log (4.2, 6.1, 6.4, 6.5, 7.0).
